description: Returns a FrontMCP docs page as Markdown, or one section of it. `path` is a path (/reference/sdk/tool), a frontmcp.dev URL, or an old docs.agentfront.dev URL, which is mapped to its page here; a #anchor in it, or `section`, picks the section. A very long page comes back as its introduction and its sections, to read one at a time. Use it once search_docs, lookup_api or list_pages has given a path, or for a docs URL you already have. The page is the one documented for `version`.

path.description: The page: /reference/sdk/tool, https://frontmcp.dev/learn/your-first-tool#declaring-a-tool, or an old docs.agentfront.dev URL.

section.description: A section's anchor, like "options". Overrides an anchor in `path`.

version.description: A documented FrontMCP version, like "1.9.4", or a minor, like "1.9", for its newest patch. Pass the version resolve_version found for the project. Defaults to the version this endpoint serves.

name: get_page
title: Read a docs page
